- Confirmation on whether Redwood will sign SCCs + UK IDTA (or provide a UK addendum) for UK-resident personal data.

Subject: Re: Initial: Transfer evidence & UK routing questions

Oliver — thanks for the clear list and the draft. Quick notes and a proposed next step below.

1) Contract stance: Redwood will execute standard EU SCCs and we offer a UK IDTA / UK addendum option for UK-resident personal data. For customers that need both we can sign SCCs + the UK addendum concurrently. Any redlines to the addendum will need legal review but we can generally accommodate standard UK security carve-outs.

2) Transfer evidence (TIA/DTIA): we can provide a single-file evidence packet containing:
   - processing diagram (data flow by region)
   - subprocessor inventory with country mapping and attestations
   - technical controls summary (encryption in transit/at rest, access controls)
   - logging & retention statement (sample retention policy and retention-by-service)
   - recent SOC2 / security attestations (if requested)

3) Onshore fallback / escrow: we support onshore fallback routing patterns (edge routing + onshore cache) as a paid configuration in Dedicated/Private. For hosted accounts we offer logical fallback and limited export snapshots for audit — we can scope an escrow approach for logs if Globex needs it.

Proposed mutual action plan:
- By Fri 2028-08-10: Redwood to share the sample evidence packet + subprocessor CSV (owner: Alex)
- By Mon 2028-08-13: Legal/Redwood to confirm any UK addendum redline acceptability (owner: Kimberly)
- By Wed 2028-08-15: Technical call to walk the TIA scope (owners: Marissa/Kimberly + Globex PD team)

I attached our transfer profile CSV to speed review. If that timeline works we can get a DocuSign route started for the SCCs/IDTA.

Alex

Oliver / Alex — adding more specifics from legal/privacy to avoid back-and-forth during your committee review. See inline requests below.

On the TIA packet: please expect the following deliverables from Redwood (we will provide a template/zip):
- Data flow diagram: high level AND a second page listing ingress/egress points by region.
- Subprocessor inventory: CSV with roles, contact, country, and whether they have subprocess commitments.
- Attestations: redacted subprocessor attestations where permitted (or a summary of controls).
- Logging evidence: example audit log extract (redacted), retention schedule, and where logs live (region + backups).
- Technical safeguards table: KMS/HSM usage, key custody, encryption algorithms, and network protections.

A few questions for Globex to confirm scope:
1) Can you confirm which categories of personal data you consider "special" for this engagement (e.g., patient identifiers, clinical notes)?
2) Required retention window for logs for audit purposes (we typically retain auth logs 90 days by default; we can extend with a policy/configuration).
3) Any mandated data residency for backups or legal hold copies?

On escrow: if you need a formal escrow of logs, we'll need to create a narrow SOW (costed) and an escrow custodian (we have preferred providers). That requires procurement sign-off on both sides.

I'll review any redlines to the UK addendum ASAP once received. For DocuSign please use the link Alex shares; we typically run addenda as parallel documents to SCCs.

Kimberly Park
Senior Privacy Counsel - Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Kimberly / Alex — thanks, this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Special categories: we will need confirmatory language around any clinical notes / diagnosis codes (patient pseudonymisation is preferred).
- Log retention: auditors ask for 12 months of auth/logging history for access reviews; would Redwood be able to offer that as an option? If not, please state an alternative export process and SLA.
- Escrow: we are open to a scoped escrow SOW. Can you send sample SOW terms and a rough cost estimate so procurement can evaluate?

Also, one small ask — do you have a minimal redlined UK addendum we can review first (we prefer to see the vendor's suggested changes before proposing ours).

Let's set up a 30-minute call Monday to walk the TIA scope and the escrow options.

Thanks,
